Branding and compatibility

The public product identity is smTO, Small Model Task Orchestration. branding.json provides presentation metadata. BrandingLoader considers an explicit loader path, SMTO_BRANDING_PATH, legacy JARVMKS_BRANDING_PATH, application configuration and the packaged fallback. It retains the last-known-good identity when a selected replacement is invalid. Branding is presentation, not policy or execution authority.

Distribution/CLI names (aor-runtime, aor), environment names (AOR_*), persisted keys, Legacy browser namespaces and API compatibility fields are retained interfaces. A documentation or branding change is not permission to rename them. Historical report titles keep the names used when their measurements were recorded.

Package metadata, runtime API, Gateway core and manual service have distinct version domains. A code-freeze label is not a replacement value for every service version. See the configuration catalog for data owners, override precedence and consumer boundaries.
